transcript.text: I've reviewed the executed option agreement, and there are two things we need to address. First, the agreement authorizes exactly 8 episodes — not the 10 called for in the draft production plan. Second, it requires the on-platform title credit to read 'Based on the novel by Celia Voss.' I should also note that my rights memo documenting these findings hasn't been filed in the production records yet.

transcript.text: Before we go further on the sound side, I need to flag a critical technical issue. I confirmed with the distribution platform's ingest engineer that delivery must be stereo at 48 kHz with mono compatibility. Binaural delivery will be rejected outright. This spec was added to the technical ticket, but it has not yet made it into the greenlight packet. Given that the draft production plan calls for binaural audio, we need to revise that approach before this package goes to production.
